description: Land Acquisition - Makavita,Matara D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a formal declaration that specific land (described by boundaries, extent, and location) is needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or detailed portfolio responsibilities of the minister. The minister's name and title are mentioned only as part of the formal declaration process, not as the primary focus of the gazette.
